## Checklist

- [ ] Pre-commit hooks installed (`pre-commit install`) and `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat: …`, `fix: …`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if the CLI or a public API changed)
- [ ] Web UI rebuilt and `src/experimaestro/webui/data/` committed (if `app/` changed)

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
